name: AuxPair.upsilon_eq_sum
summary: Both sides are data named from residue functions on matrices modulo MQ; the translates by the lifts of A^(-1) move the level indicator so that its incl-rows at Q become A. Comparing the functions at a matrix x: if the incl-rows of x at every place of Q are invertible, exactly one A contributes and gives prod psi(det); otherwise both sides vanish.

steps.claim: Write auxDatum(O) and each term of the sum as data named from residue functions (moving from the modulus M^2 Q to MQ), let K_0 act on modDatum by translating the residue function (pairWeil_modDatum_Kf), and use linearity of the naming: it suffices that the two residue functions agree at every matrix x modulo MQ.
steps.lean:
simp_rw [← Prod.mk_one_one, ← (Kf ..).coe_one, auxDatum,
    liftFn_eq_residueDatum places_levelModulus, ← liftFn_eq_residueDatum
    (places_levelModulus (c := 1)), pairWeil_modDatum_Kf, modDatum_vacVector, places_levelModulus,
    ← _root_.smul_apply, ← _root_.sum_apply, ← map_smul, ← map_sum]; congr 3 with x

steps.claim: At x: the left side is resDetDatum(O)(x) = prod over w in Q of psi_w(det of the incl-rows of x_w) if x_w is the inclusion matrix at every w in M, else 0; the A-term of the right side is the level indicator at x translated by twistLift(O, A) (whose reductions are A^(-1) at Q and 1 at M), times the value of the character at the determinant of twistLift(O, A), given by the tame parts (apply_det_eq_prod); the translated indicator is 1 exactly when x is the inclusion matrix at M and the incl-rows of x at each w in Q equal A_w.
steps.lean:
simp [O.hasWeight.hasWeight_rankTwist.apply_det_eq_prod O.apart.1 O.tame_eq_one, levelIndicator,
    LevelPlaces.twistLift, resDetDatum, submatrix_mul (e₂ := id), ← inv_apply', (congrFun
    (reduceFamily_liftResidue ..) : ∀ _, Kf.reduceAt _ _ = _), mul_inv_eq_iff_eq_mul_of_invertible]

steps.claim: Case split on whether, at every place of Q, the incl-rows of x form an invertible matrix.
steps.lean: by_cases z : ∀ i, IsUnit (((vecToMat x).map (levelResidueAt (.inr i))).submatrix O.incl id)

steps.claim: If they do, call them A_w: exactly the term A of the sum survives, and it equals prod_w psi_w(det A_w), the left side.
steps.lean: choose A e using z; simp [← e, Units.val_inj, ← funext_iff, ite_and, inv_apply_eq_inv']

steps.claim: Otherwise some incl-row block has determinant 0, so psi of it is 0 and the left side vanishes; and no A makes the indicator 1, so the right side vanishes.
